The '''''Eddicus''-class planetary shuttles''' were [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] utilized by members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Named for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Anwis Eddicus]], the craft was developed by a Senate committee as an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] counterpart to the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation's]] [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class space cruiser]]. At the behest of committee member [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the task was taken to [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]], although the rest of the committee did not know that Palpatine had secret ties to the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] company. As a result, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] Senator was able to have secret [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] built into all the craft, allowing him to obtain exclusive insider information. When deployed, the ''Eddicus''-class became a mainstay in the skies of the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]].

==Description==
The [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] ''Eddicus''-class [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], measuring thirty-two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, was an original design but one that hewed closely to common design sensibilities. Passengers were protected by [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], and a sophisticated on-board security suite featured a [[sound-dampening field]], in addition to countermeasures preventing any electronic surveillance. Despite this, the shuttle also contained concealed [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] within its security systems. Toward the bow of the craft, guards could observe from a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]]-domed station. The shuttles painted [[Color/Legends|blue]] were in service to the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|office]]&mdash;blue being the representative color of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="db" /> In spite of this, the Chancellor's personal shuttle was painted red, the official color of consular craft.<ref name="yjccc">{{YJCCG|set=Menace of Darth Maul|cardname=Planetary Shuttle|link=battleofnaboo/light/images/37planetaryshuttle.gif}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Planetsh.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Supreme Chancellor's personal ''Eddicus''-class planetary shuttle]]
The ''Eddicus''-class planetary shuttle was commissioned as a formal mode of transport in diplomatic situations. The standard craft for such a task were the spacefaring [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruisers]], but an atmospheric equivalent was required. A subcommittee was created to oversee the project, and they eventually decided to commission Kuat Systems Engineering. One of the committee members, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of<ref name="db" /> the planet<ref name="tpm">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], had advised against using the builders of the ''Consular''-class, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], lest there be any accusations of Senate bias toward the company.<ref name="db" />

In reality, Palpatine had his own ties to Kuat Systems Engineering, which allowed him to make his own modifications without the interference of his fellow committee members. He instructed the Kuati engineers to plant hidden surveillance devices in the shuttle's security systems, in order to record the conversations that politicians using the craft thought they were making in private. The recordings made were only available to Palpatine himself and a few select technicians. The other specifics of the design were classified, and only available to select members of the committee.<ref name="db" />

The line was named for Chancellor [[Anwis Eddicus]], who was instrumental in ending the devastating [[Death Seed]] plague many years before. When the model was deployed<ref name="db" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''Eddicus''-class planetary shuttle appears in {{Film|I}}, which is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> it became a common sight in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In addition to being used by the Supreme Chancellor himself, use of the shuttles were offered to honored guests, such as [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of Naboo. Palpatine was able to glean a considerable amount of valuable information and insider knowledge from his hidden listening devices, and neither Supreme Chancellors [[Kalpana (Supreme Chancellor)/Legends|Kalpana]] or [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] were ever aware of the senator's machinations.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Eddicus''-class planetary shuttle first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="tpm" /> In [[2007]], [[James McFadden]] identified and fleshed out the details of the shuttles through [[StarWars.com]]'s "[[What's The Story?]]" [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature.<ref name="db" />
